title: acer monspessulanum subsp. assyriacum
intro: Acer monspessulanum subsp. assyriacum, commonly known as Assyrian maple, is a subspecies of the maples belonging to the family Sapindaceae. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the Middle East and Mediterranean regions. The health benefits of Acer monspessulanum subsp. assyriacum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing inflammation, preventing cell damage, and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as cardiovascular protection, hepatoprotective effects, and antispasmodic properties.
